title: Official, Target-Memory, and Station Family Experts
mission: Train the long-history official residual expert, target-memory expert and station microclimate expert with genuine temporal OOF predictions.
steps: Train constrained boosting candidates with nested temporal tuning.
Official expert predicts actual minus official anchor with source-era structure.
Target-memory expert predicts Tmax or official residual using long history.
Station expert predicts small residual correction and expected error; separate proxy/live status.
Generate OOF predictions and feature ablations.
Cap corrections and compare with causal residual-memory baseline.
acceptance: At least one OOF artifact per expert
Weak experts retained only as diagnostics/fallback
failure: Station proxy status prevents production promotion until availability proof
